steps.en: Install the harness package, plus a provider extra if you are not on Bedrock
steps.zh: 装上 harness 包；不用 Bedrock 就再装对应 extra

steps.en: Build the agent in one call — every argument is optional
steps.zh: 一次调用把 agent 建出来，参数全可省

steps.en: Wires a tuned system prompt, shell and file tools, a code sandbox and a subagent
steps.zh: 接好调过的 system prompt、shell 与文件工具、代码沙箱和子代理

steps.en: Keeps sessions, long-term memory and skills in one dot-directory it owns
steps.zh: 把会话、长期记忆和技能放进它自己管的那个点目录

steps.code: agent("Find the slowest test in this repo and explain why it's slow")

steps.en: Runs the loop, calls tools, summarizes old turns and reuses cached context
steps.zh: 跑循环、调工具、把旧轮次摘要掉、复用缓存过的上下文

value.en: You no longer hand-assemble the loop, its tools, memory and sessions: one call gives you a working agent, and every default stays overridable
value.zh: 你不用再自己攒循环、工具、记忆和会话：一次调用就有能用的 agent，而每个默认值都留着覆盖口

sources: harness-py/README.md (pip install strands-harness; create_harness() returns a plain strands.Agent; the default tool set incl. shell, read/write/edit, web_fetch, programmatic_tool_caller and subagent; sessions in ./.agent/sessions, memory in ./.agent/memory, skills in ./.agent/skills; every default overridable; provider extras [openai]/[anthropic]/[gemini]/[ollama]/[litellm])

README.md quick start and Working with the SDK sections (pip install strands-harness; agent("Find the slowest test in this repo and explain why it's slow"); provider/model string; model-agnostic provider list)
harness-py/pyproject.toml (runtime deps strands-agents[otel], pydantic, pydantic-monty; requires-python >=3.10; optional extras per provider)
site/src/content/docs/user-guide/harness/quickstart (sessions on by default under ./.agent/sessions; model passed as provider/name; Bedrock is the default)
